_doc: The selected path is a 16-segment zigzag of straight lines, 6 units high. Every point is within the 100-unit smoothing radius, so the pass refits the run with error 8. The path keeps its MoveTo (the refit never replaces one; before this case it did, and the smoothed path started from an implied origin) and ends with fewer commands than it had: 17 become 15.
name: smooth_zigzag
